name: ai-india-roast-room
description: The AI India Roast Room: twelve AI advisors built from the public work of Nithin Kamath, Sridhar Vembu, Kunal Shah, Falguni Nayar, Narayana Murthy, Uday Kotak, Aman Gupta, Anupam Mittal, Aadit Palicha, Raj Shamani, Raghuram Rajan, and Amitabh Bachchan (plus any you add with /newroaster) debate an Indian founder's decision in Hinglish, in rupees, live around a table.
